profile.headline: Orange you glad I didn't talk about myself.
profile.summary:
My name is pronounced like “Hup, 2, 3, 4..", but I’m used to going by Lee. I will respond to either! 

Software Developer with B.S. in Computer Science and 2~ years of experience with Logistic Solutions development team. Part of a development team that is first for the company to implement a modular framework with scalability, code readability, and testability in mind (approved to continue with modular architecture after project evaluation, upon completion of first module). 

Took lead in rebuilding WebUI from scratch (Vue JS), due to instability and latency in the existing front-end framework (Angular). With the completion of the new WebUI; increased code delivery speed, UI/UX instability and latency no longer an issues, and scalable with any spring framework modules, regardless of the project.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Vue.js · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Java Software Developer
positions.description:
• Retrofit a warehouse management and material flow system; from a monolithic framework written in PL/SQL to a modular framework with macro-services written in Java
• Convert PL/SQL business logic to Java equivalent
• Frontend fixes using Angular framework: Javascript, CSS, HTML
• Rebuilt WebUI using VueJs 2 with Spring framework for faster and more responsive UI/UX experience for the customer, portability, and faster turn around time for issues
• Use Docker containers for local deployment
• SQL database for our relational database
• Spring boot and Spring Framework implementation for one project
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Modular Framework · Jenkins · Spring Framework · Git

positions.title: QA Software Tester
positions.description:
• Front-end UI/UX testing on iOS and Android devices for a Trucking Logistics application
• Execute test cases and report bugs to developers

positions.title: Applecare Technical Support
positions.description:
• Build a rapport with frustrated customers calling for support while keeping a positive image of Apple
• Providing solutions to software related issues using knowledge learned from CS courses to ask the right questions, pin point and isolate the bug, and distinguishing between software and hardware issues

positions.title: Lab and Teachers Assistant
positions.description: Lab TA for a professor in Food, Nutrition, and Packaging Science.
